request: Owner requested Radiohead Jigsaw Falling Into Place as another practice song.

reference.creator: Cole Johnstone (BEST GUITAR TUTORIALS)
reference.scope: Creator describes a standard-tuning lesson and lists Bm among its intro chords. Official embed/link only.

additional_context.creator: Dave Doing Guitar
additional_context.scope: Creator explicitly teaches DADF#BE tuning. Not selected for standard-tuning in-app chord diagrams.

implementation_plan: A full 101-target, 14-section easy accompaniment for the specified cover. Eight existing open chord shapes, EADGBE + capo 2, no barre. Bm→Am, F#/A#→E, Dmaj7→Cmaj7, D6→Am7 (same pitch classes with different bass), Gmaj7→Fmaj7, F#m/F#m7→Em, Em/Em9→Dm, A→G. Bm/D is reduced to Am. Harmonic embellishments and bass motion are omitted, not presented as the original guitar part.
boundaries: The Bm preparation remains separate; the video course supplies a complete simplified accompaniment, not the original riff or exact bass/finger performance.
App accompaniment and chord recognition use standard EADGBE + capo 2; the performance video uses DADF#BE, and its fret positions must not be copied to the standard-tuned guitar.
Teacher media remain in the official player and are never cached or downloaded.
full_song_request: Owner explicitly requested one complete easy-chord accompaniment with chord diagrams following the video clock.

performance.creator: imamuzx
performance.scope: Full sung acoustic cover, including its additional final chorus; embed/link only. Video uses DADF#BE. App accompaniment is its own simplified standard EADGBE + capo 2 voicing guide.

harmonic_references.scope: Publisher preview confirms harmonic families and alternate tuning; no notation, TAB, diagram or image copied.

harmonic_references.creator: Nikola Gugoski
harmonic_references.scope: Public primary tutorial, section structure cross-check only; no downloadable TAB accessed.

timing.method: Manual decoded-frame inspection of the official embedded cover at 2-second sampling; hand and on-screen chord/bass patterns cross-checked, then a coarse simplified accompaniment was aligned. The guide is approximate and supports a device-local +/-2 second display adjustment.
timing.stored_data: Chord labels, section names and numeric seconds only. All verification screenshots remain ignored and outside the release archive.
